'''November 2001 Lancaster, California tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, California on 30 November 2001. [[Cat Ceder]] won it. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3140">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-03-lancaster-and-back-11-30-01d3140/ lancaster-and-back-11-30-01], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 3 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-03-lancaster-and-back-11-30-01d3140/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Cat Ceder]]
